A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in which he participated as a [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel Marksman]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Rebel Dead-Eye" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artists [[Darren Tan]] and [[Kai Lim]].
